original_source_statement_tex:
\label{lemma-flat-pullback-exact}
Let $f : \Sh(\mathcal{C}) \to \Sh(\mathcal{C}')$
be a morphism of ringed topoi. Then
$$
f^{-1} : \textit{Ab}(\mathcal{C}') \longrightarrow \textit{Ab}(\mathcal{C}),
\quad
\mathcal{F} \longmapsto f^{-1}\mathcal{F}
$$
is exact. If
$(f, f^\sharp) :
(\Sh(\mathcal{C}), \mathcal{O})
\to
(\Sh(\mathcal{C}'), \mathcal{O}')$
is a flat morphism of ringed topoi then
$$
f^* : \textit{Mod}(\mathcal{O}') \longrightarrow \textit{Mod}(\mathcal{O}),
\quad
\mathcal{F} \longmapsto f^*\mathcal{F}
$$
is exact.

semantic_review_note: There are two related, differently conditioned exactness claims: inverse image f^{-1} is exact on abelian sheaves for a topos morphism, and module pullback f^* is exact for a flat ringed-topos morphism. The stronger flatness premise is kept for f^*.
